user.title: Monitor Z-Wave JS and ZHA devices
user.description: Include all current and future Z-Wave JS and ZHA end devices. Repairs offer to enable diagnostic entities and separately warn after 24 hours without communication. Nothing is enabled without confirmation. Ignoring any device repair excludes that device from BOTH checks until you include it again in the integration options. Closing a repair dialog does not exclude it.

abort.already_configured: Garath Device Health is already configured.

init.title: Device exclusions and snoozes
init.description:
All supported devices are included by default. Excluded devices are omitted from BOTH checks. Ignoring a device repair adds it here. Remove an exclusion to resume monitoring.

No-contact snoozes affect only the 24-hour communication warning. Each snoozed device is listed with its snoozed-until time in your Home Assistant time zone. Select devices under Unsnooze devices to end their snoozes early; leave them unselected to keep snoozing.

options.exclude: Exclude this device permanently from all monitoring
options.snooze_day: Snooze the no-contact warning for 24 hours
options.snooze_week: Snooze the no-contact warning for 7 days
options.snooze_30_days: Snooze the no-contact warning for 30 days

diagnostics.title: Enable diagnostics for {device}
diagnostics.description: These diagnostic entities are disabled: {details}. Use the repair flow to enable them, or exclude this device. This changes Home Assistant entity settings, not device parameters. Last-seen monitoring is independent. Ignoring this repair excludes the device from BOTH checks; closing the dialog does not.

error.enable_failed: Could not enable diagnostics. See the details above and retry.
error.invalid_action: Choose one of the listed actions.

abort.issue_gone: This issue is no longer active.
abort.not_loaded: Garath Device Health is not loaded.
abort.excluded: This device is excluded. Include it again in integration options.

diagnostics_unavailable.title: Diagnostics unavailable for {device}
diagnostics_unavailable.description: These expected diagnostic entities are missing or blocked by a disabled device/config entry: {details}. They cannot be enabled by this flow. Check the owning integration, finish device discovery, and check device/entity settings. Last-seen monitoring continues independently. Ignoring this repair excludes this device from BOTH checks. Re-enable monitoring in integration options.

last_seen_unknown.title: Last-seen time is unknown for {device}
last_seen_unknown.description: {details} Check the owning integration and allow the device to communicate normally, or wake it manually according to its instructions. This is not a claim that the device has failed. No stale-device determination is made until a timestamp is known. Ignoring this repair excludes this device from BOTH checks. Re-enable monitoring in integration options.

stale.title: No communication observed for {device} in 24 hours
stale.description:
Last observed communication (UTC): {details}.

Check power, batteries, range, and the owning integration. Some healthy battery devices communicate less frequently than daily. Open this repair to snooze the no-contact warning for 24 hours, 7 days, or 30 days, or permanently exclude the device. Snoozing keeps diagnostic checks active. This repair clears automatically when communication resumes. It does not ping or wake devices. Ignoring this repair excludes this device from BOTH checks. Manage exclusions and snoozes in integration options.

confirm.title: No-contact warning for {device}
confirm.description:
Last observed communication (UTC): {details}.

Snooze this warning for 24 hours, 7 days, or 30 days without disabling diagnostic checks or changing the last-contact time. Snoozes survive restarts and can be ended early in integration options. When a snooze expires, the next scan warns again only if communication is still overdue.

Permanent exclusion and Home Assistant's Ignore action both disable ALL monitoring checks for this device. Closing this dialog changes nothing.

abort.excluded: This device is excluded. Include it again in integration options.

source_unavailable.title: Device health monitoring paused for {protocol}
source_unavailable.description:
Cannot read the owning integration: {details}.

Restore the integration connection and check the Home Assistant logs. No new device conclusions are made for this protocol while it is unavailable; existing device issues are retained. The other protocol continues to be monitored. This warning clears when monitoring resumes. Ignoring this source warning does not exclude devices.
